versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00167 If OsScalabilityClass is SC3 or SC4, or system is Multi-Core, AND a Task is referenced within an alarm object AND the OS-Application of the alarm has no access to the Task , the consistency check shall issue an error.
